newsitem.title: UK: Eurotunnel says reopening tunnel awaits IGC.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel says reopening tunnel awaits IGC.

text.p: Eurotunnel Plc said on Wednesday that its initial plans for the reopening of the Channel Tunnel would be announced as soon as the Intergovernmental Commission (IGC) gives its authorisation.
The Anglo-French link was closed after a blaze on a freight truck on a shuttle train injured eight people and damaged 600 metres of the south rail tunnel.
Eurotunnel said that technical teams examined the parallel north rail tunnel and established it should be possible to allow single line services to resume at some stage during Wednesday.
An assessment of the effects and consequences of the incident and the work needed to restore the south rail tunnel to full working order is underway, the company added.
